definitions.explanation: The administrative office of a town ({町|まち}). Handles resident registration, tax collection, permits, and other local government services. Equivalent to a city hall but for smaller municipalities classified as {町|まち}.

examples.japanese: {町役場|まちやくば}で{届|とど}けを{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I submitted the notification at the town hall.

examples.japanese: {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}は{町役場|まちやくば}の{窓口|まどぐち}で{手続|てつづ}きできます。
examples.english: You can process your move-in registration at the town hall counter.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{町役場|まちやくば}の{建物|たてもの}が{駅前|えきまえ}に{完成|かんせい}して、{住民|じゅうみん}にとって{便利|べんり}になった。
examples.english: The new town hall building was completed in front of the station, making things more convenient for residents.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for municipalities classified as {町|まち}. Larger municipalities classified as {市|し} use {市役所|しやくしょ} (city hall), while villages use {村役場|むらやくば} (village office). In Japanese administrative structure, {町|まち} falls between {市|し} (city) and {村|むら} (village).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {町役場|まちやくば}の{窓口|まどぐち}: town hall counter
- {町役場|まちやくば}に{届|とど}けを{出|だ}す: file a notification at the town hall
- {町役場|まちやくば}の{職員|しょくいん}: town hall staff
